description:
Each tracked artifact in the five terminal-owned or ownerless `dev/active/` entries listed below, plus the empty untracked leftover directories listed in the investigation's Appendix A (recorded with the deletion disposition) present at commit `7641561a9` receives one manifest row with ownership evidence, code consumers and a disposition, so regrouping and archival act only on defensible ownership.

## Background

Ownership is admissible only from an existing tracker document reference, an unambiguous issue identifier in the path or content, or unique `jit:<short-id>` commit provenance; an artifact without admissible evidence is unassociated and goes to `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`. `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` Appendix A gives the 2026-10-01 entry classification (classes (b), (b-empty) and (c)) and the method used to derive it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The manifest holds one row per tracked file in the frozen entry list below (the five terminal-owned or ownerless `dev/active/` entries listed below, plus the empty untracked leftover directories listed in the investigation's Appendix A (recorded with the deletion disposition) present at commit `7641561a9`), with owner or association evidence, owning top-level epic, bundle relationships and disposition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every ownership claim cites an admissible evidence class; rows without admissible evidence carry the legacy-archive disposition.
- [hard] REQ-03: Entries shared by several epics record every owner and the destination chosen by the multi-owner rule.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each entry whose path a non-comment consumer reads or checks (production code, tests, scripts, measurement tooling, relative Cargo paths or configuration) is marked code-pinned and records every such consumer by file and line, and each digest-pinned machine input in the entry is marked.
- [hard] REQ-05: The progress checker reports the shard's rows schema-valid with every source assertion passing.

## Notes

Frozen entry list: `37e0b235`, `babcf05e-gf2-core-ppc-spiral`, `charon-patch-backup-2026-05-15`, `DOCUMENTATION_AUDIT.md`, `e095a100-gfpm-arithmetic`. Entries created after commit `7641561a9` are outside this migration; the `@/inv/active-document-layout` invariant governs them at creation.
title: Inventory terminal, ownerless and empty dev/active entries
